# KingxTech

> KingxTech lets people build, host and ship web apps with an AI assistant (K-XpertAI). It also offers an OpenAI-compatible text API.

Docs: https://auth.kingxtech.name.ng/docs
API guide: https://auth.kingxtech.name.ng/docs/api

## KingxTech API (for AI assistants helping someone build with it)

- Base URL: https://site.kingxtech.name.ng
- Endpoints (API keys work ONLY on these two): GET /api/v1/models and POST /api/v1/chat/completions. No embeddings, images, audio, files or tool calling.
- Auth: header `Authorization: Bearer kx_live_...`. The user makes a key in Console > AI Lab > API Key Vault (shown once).
- Body: {"model": "...", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}]}. Answer: choices[0].message.content. Text only. Last 40 messages used. No memory between requests.
- OpenAI SDK works: baseURL = https://site.kingxtech.name.ng/api/v1, apiKey = the KingxTech key.
- Get model ids from GET /api/v1/models. Free models work on every plan; stronger ones need Pro or Pro+.
- Paid per request from the user's KingxTech wallet. Limit: 10 requests per minute per account.
- Errors: 401 bad/missing/revoked key; 402 wallet too low, plan needed or monthly model limit; 403 needs Pro+ or key used on a wrong address; 429 rate limited; 502 provider problem.
- The key is a secret. Never put it in browser/front-end code. Call from a server and keep the key in an environment variable. Published KingxTech sites are static, so they cannot hold a secret.
- KingxTech does not run server code or serverless functions for published sites, so do not create functions/ or api/ folders expecting them to run.
- To add AI to a site published on KingxTech, use the project's "AI for your site" feature (Site Settings > AI): the page calls POST /api/public/ai/<projectId>/chat with {"messages":[...]} and no key, and reads `reply`. The owner pays from their wallet; there is a daily limit.
